units.source_text: 只此数语，想到便写，似乎尚未结束，就此把信包好，送了出去。

en.t: With only these few words written down as they came to mind, and seeming not yet finished, she wrapped up the letter and sent it off.

units.source_text: 藏人少将和侍女们谈话，其中有言：“

en.t: The Lieutenant of the Palace Guards spoke with the waiting women, and among other things said, "

units.source_text: 我是常来之客，教我坐在帘外檐下，似觉孤独无依。

en.t: I am a frequent visitor here, yet being made to sit outside the blinds under the eaves makes me feel lonely and forlorn.

units.source_text: 今后我们又将结下新的缘分，我更要常常来访了。

en.t: From now on we shall form a new bond as well, so I will have even more reason to visit often.

units.source_text: 我想过去多年间我常来效劳，为此微功，请允许我自由出入，做个入幕之宾吧。”

en.t: When I think how for many years I have often come here to be of service, I ask that in return for this small merit you allow me to come and go freely, as one admitted within the curtain."

units.source_text: 他表示了这意思之后，就告辞回去。

en.t: After expressing this meaning, he took his leave and went home.
